"""Main resolves only qualified-source overlaps and integrates the tested server port."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
U = G / '.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012'
W = G / '.worktree/perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('current_replica_integrate_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
           GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes')

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-update-replica-integrate-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
             source={'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': m.sha(Path(__file__))}, evidence={})

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, cwd=U, allowed=(0,), wall=180):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 6 + 60,
                             rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return c['exit_code'], so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        pub = B / 'main-current-update-replica-publication-root-v1/record.json'
        p = json.loads(pub.read_text())
        assert p['passed'] and p['complete'] and not p['active']
        assert p['commit'] == 'de1bfe79296bac235bfd6eaf801d2e353458e1fb'
        lint = json.loads((B / 'main-current-update-replica-lints-root-v7/record.json').read_text())
        full = json.loads((B / 'main-current-update-replica-full-root-v2/record.json').read_text())
        assert lint['passed'] and full['passed'] and not full['active']
        r['publication_receipt'] = dict(path=str(pub), sha256=m.sha(pub))
        for name, tree in [('combined', U), ('tuning', W)]:
            assert run(name + '-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], tree)[1] == 'ee975816a0beb4616179f4ad05208fbef7c36899'
            assert not run(name + '-clean', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], tree)[1]
        status, _ = run('merge-qualified-source', ['git', 'merge', '--no-ff', '--no-commit', p['commit']], allowed=(0, 1))
        conflicts = run('conflict-list', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=U'])[1].splitlines()
        if status:
            assert conflicts and set(conflicts) <= set(lint['changed_source_pins'])
            run('resolve-qualified-overlaps', ['git', 'restore', '--source=' + p['commit'],
                                              '--staged', '--worktree', '--', *conflicts])
        assert not run('remaining-conflicts', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=U'])[1]
        r['resolved_conflicts'] = conflicts
        assert all(m.sha(U / path) == h for path, h in full['source_pins'].items())
        r['source_equivalence'] = dict(files_checked=len(full['source_pins']), matched=True,
                                       exact_full_test_receipt_sha256=m.sha(B / 'main-current-update-replica-full-root-v2/record.json'))
        run('inference-source-unchanged', ['git', 'diff', '--exit-code', 'ee975816a0beb4616179f4ad05208fbef7c36899',
                                         '--', 'src', 'include', 'CMakeLists.txt', 'cmake', 'third_party'])
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check', '--cached'])
        run('commit-integration', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'feat(serve): integrate v0.1.43 server functionality'])
        r['commit'] = run('integrated-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])[1]
        run('push-integration', ['git', 'push', 'origin', 'sync/latest-updates-20261012'])
        assert not run('combined-clean-final', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])[1]
        run('advance-tuning', ['git', 'merge', '--ff-only', r['commit']], W)
        run('push-tuning', ['git', 'push', 'origin', 'perf/native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'], W)
        assert not run('tuning-clean-final', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], W)[1]
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'complete', 'error', 'commit', 'resolved_conflicts')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
